task: Replicate the approved Hima UI as a pixel-faithful React Native (Expo, TypeScript) Android app in mobile/.

source_of_truth.on_conflict: design files win for visuals, spec wins for behavior; ask if money or payment logic is affected

replication_rules: Copy, do not redesign, restyle, simplify or 'improve' anything.
Port each HTML element 1:1: flex div -> View with the same flex props; px -> same dp at 360 width; inline styles -> StyleSheet values read from mobile/theme.
Same copy text, icons (lucide-react-native), corner radii, shadows, spacing and states as the design file.
If something cannot match exactly in React Native, get as close as possible and list the difference.

stack.assets: copy design/assets/* to mobile/assets/mascot and mobile/assets/illustrations

hard_rules: All colors, font sizes and spacing come from mobile/theme (colors.ts, typography.ts, spacing.ts), including the extra contrast and tint tokens in design/README.md. No hex values inside screens.
Build the shared components from Components.html first and reuse them everywhere.
Money: peso sign, comma thousands, two decimals, tabular figures, true minus sign.
Never show a payment as successful before it is confirmed. No mascot on pending or failed payments.
Status is always icon + label + color.
AI never changes the plan without explicit approval; numbers in AI answers come from backend calculations.
Safe-to-Spend = wallet balance - remaining planned expenses this period - protected reserves. Deterministic, outside the UI, unit-tested.
Sample data in the designs is placeholder only: wire screens to stores/services with mock data, not hardcoded values.
Touch targets >= 44x44, safe areas, keyboard avoidance, screen-reader labels, reduced motion.

batches.name: Scaffold
batches.do: Expo app in mobile/, theme tokens from Foundations.html, fonts, assets, expo-router skeleton with (auth), (onboarding), (tabs), payment, assistant.

batches.name: Components
batches.do: Every component on the board, all variants and states.

per_screen_check: Run on a 360-wide Android emulator and screenshot the screen.
Open the matching design/screens/<name>.html in a browser at 360 px wide.
Compare layout, spacing, sizes, colors, text and icons; fix differences before moving on.
If no emulator is available, say so and compare the code against the HTML values instead.
workflow: Do one batch at a time, in order.
Before each batch, list the files you will create; after it, run type-check and lint, and report what was built, what differs from the design, and anything you need from me.
Stop after each batch and wait for my go-ahead.
